ade.lineageGutter.description: Mark lines a turn of the conversation wrote.

ade.openSessionIn.description: Where a session in another checkout opens. A new window keeps the one you are in: reusing it closes every tab you had open. A window with no folder open is reused either way.

ade.afterCloseSession.description: What this window does once the session is closed. Closing it quits the editor when it is the last one open. The window stays either way if the worktree could not be removed, so you can read why.

ade.sessionsPerCheckout.description: How many sessions a checkout lists before the rest go behind one row. 0 lists them all.

ade.design.fontFamily.description: Font for design documents opened as they read. Empty uses the editor's interface font.

ade.design.fontSize.description: Font size, in pixels, for design documents opened as they read. 0 uses the editor's font size.

ade.design.diagramFontSize.description: Font size, in pixels, for mermaid diagrams in design documents. A diagram wider than the page scrolls rather than shrinks.

ade.defaultReviewers.description: Named agents ticked in advance by "Review the diff with named agents". A name this machine has no reviewer for is ignored.

viewsWelcome.contents:
